agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday, October 8, 2025, in Community Services Committee Report 18.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Monday, September 22, 2025, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Tuesday, September 23, 2025.

sub_agendas_items.title: Motion – Councillor S. Plante – Renaming Emond Park to Mary Papatsie Park

attachments.attachment_title: Motion report - S. Plante - Mary Papatsie Park (AODA).pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
In response to questions from Committee, Dan Chenier, General Manager, Recreation, Cultural and Facility Services, undertook to work with the Ward Councillor to consider park signage in Inuktitut and/or Algonquin as well as French and English.
Chris Greenshields (Vanier Community Association) spoke and provided comments on the item.
There were no written submissions on this item.
Following discussions, Committee considered the motion as follows.

motions.motion_text:
Motion
BE IT RESOLVED that the Community Services Committee recommend that Council approve the following:
